title: HF29 (2021, First Special): Medical cannabis registry enrollee provided to not be denied the right to purchase, own, possess, or carry a firearm.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/92/2021/1/HF/29/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced version (first special session 2021). Sections 1-4 are definitions. Section 7 adds a carry-while-impaired ban for registry patients and strikes only a word and punctuation. Passed no vote in the text read (none listed). Added vs. kept words are not marked in the saved text; quotes were chosen from the new passages.

operative_text:
Section 5 (Minn. Stat. 624.713, subd. 1): The use of medical cannabis by a patient enrolled in the registry program does not constitute the unlawful use of a controlled substance under this item;
Section 5 (Minn. Stat. 624.713, subd. 1): Participation as a patient in the registry program does not disqualify the person from possessing firearms and ammunition under this section.
Section 6 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 6): A sheriff shall not deny an application for a permit to carry solely because the applicant is a patient enrolled in the registry program and uses medical cannabis for a qualifying medical condition.
Section 7 (Minn. Stat. 624.7142, subd. 1): when the person is enrolled as a patient in the registry program, uses medical cannabis, and knows or has reason to know that the medical cannabis used by the person has the capacity to cause impairment.
Section 8 (Minn. Stat. 624.7151): Any form used for the purpose of approving or disapproving a person from purchasing, owning, possessing, or carrying a firearm that inquires about the applicant's use of controlled substances shall specifically authorize a patient in the registry program to refrain from reporting the use of medical cannabis.
Section 9 (Minn. Stat. 624.7152, subd. (a)): A person may not be denied the right to purchase, own, possess, or carry a firearm solely on the basis that the person is a patient in the registry program.
Section 9 (Minn. Stat. 624.7152, subd. (b)): A state or local agency may not access a database containing the identities of patients in the registry program to obtain information for the purpose of approving or disapproving a person from purchasing, owning, possessing, or carrying a firearm.
Section 9 (Minn. Stat. 624.7152, subd. (d)): A state or local agency may not inquire about a person's status as a patient in the registry program for the purpose of approving or disapproving the person from purchasing, owning, possessing, or carrying a firearm.
